title: The Plan pop-up is split into Overview, To-dos, Talk and History, and names its owner

source.ref: Plans and calendar clarity audit 2026-11-25 (project thread: Audit the project and calendar system; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/GUTHmChGkqaEmPSRUdzJHz)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-25: one max-w-lg dialog holds about 12 blocks (summary, manifest fields, repeats, to-dos, Find a time, event repair, sharing, comments, activity, archive). The owner reads 'Assigned teammate' instead of a name, and every Plan is subtitled '<kind> production record' even at Pencil. Builds on LIVE-2544 (one line per to-do, PR #5499). Fix: four tabs; Overview carries stage, owner by name, dates and readiness; Find a time shows only when the Plan has two or more candidate dates; sharing sits behind one Share button; the subtitle drops 'production record' before Production. DONE 2026-11-26: the pop-up has four tabs (Overview, To-dos with its open count, Talk, History). Overview carries stage, the owner by name (from the to-do people list), readiness, the form, Find a time, the event link and the actions; sharing waits behind one 'Share this Plan' button. The subtitle reads '<kind> Plan' until Production, then '<kind> in production'. Find a time still renders for a one-date Plan so Vera's times (LIVE-2532) stay reachable.

verify.note: Passes while the Plan pop-up has tabs, names its owner and never calls a Plan a production record.
